encoder_labels: Each encoder is named after its first pipeline; a coalesced encoder may contain many different kernels.
encoder_coverage: Encoder timestamp profiling covers tracked encoders. Planned scope creation uses the stage-timing encoder directly, bypassing the separate encoder-timing helper. Untimed remainder therefore includes uninstrumented GPU work and cannot be read as GPU idle time or driver overhead.
stage_samples: Use separately selected coarse stage frames for attention/FFN attribution. Instrumentation may change encoder boundaries; sampled rates are excluded from throughput comparisons.
aggregate_scope: Encoder totals accumulate for the process and may include warmup/serial references; do not treat them as exclusively timed-batch totals without subtracting a baseline.
decode_sample_limitation: The sixteen selected decode samples are exhausted by serial/warm requests before OCR_POLICY round=0. No timed parallel-decode GPU samples were collected. Future diagnostic61 starts decode sampling at frame 320, after 302 warm decode frames.
